title: 1953 Kingman crash and Upshot-Knothole

I just want to say that that there's no question in my mind that Kingman was the real thing.
tellings.difference: Dolan just says Kingman was real, crediting Raymond Fowler, and says nothing about Upshot-Knothole testing bringing the craft down.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell the 1953 Kingman, Arizona crash as a real crash retrieval; the story's telling adds only a possible nuclear-test cause.

plain: A craft is said to have crashed near Kingman, Arizona, in 1953, possibly knocked down by American nuclear testing. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says testimonies point to the crash, and that the nuclear tests of Operation Upshot-Knothole, a series of US atomic bomb tests that year, may have "messed with" the craft. The UFO historian Richard Dolan says only that there is "no question in my mind that Kingman was the real thing," crediting the researcher Raymond Fowler. Dolan says nothing about the bomb tests bringing it down. If true, it would mean nuclear blasts can disrupt such craft.
